maddeler.e:
أعرنكس (form IIIq)
# أَعْرَنْكِسُ (ʔaʕrankisu) /ʔaʕ.ran.ki.su/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِعْرَنْكَسَ (iʕrankasa)
# أُعْرَنْكَسُ (ʔuʕrankasu) /ʔuʕ.ran.ka.su/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْرَنْكَسَ (iʕrankasa)
# أَعْرَنْكِسَ (ʔaʕrankisa) /ʔaʕ.ran.ki.sa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِعْرَنْكَسَ (iʕrankasa)
# أُعْرَنْكَس
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
